settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Language and notification preferences for your account
settings.languageHint: Your language for everything — the whole app, plus every SMS and email your school sends you.
settings.notificationsHint: How Temari.et and your school may reach you.
settings.smsHint: Fee reminders, registration notices and important updates.
settings.emailHint: Copies of important notices, when you have an email on file.

payments.failed: The payment could not be verified.
